ei.subject: 영어

fullPassage: Managers frequently try to play psychologist, to "figure out" why an employee has acted in a certain way. Empathizing with employees in order to understand their point of view can be very helpful. However, when dealing with a problem area, in particular, remember that it is not the person who is bad, but the actions exhibited on the job. Avoid making suggestions to employees about personal traits they should change; instead suggest more acceptable ways of performing. For example, instead of focusing on a person's "unreliability," a manager might focus on the fact that the employee "has been late to work seven times this month." It is difficult for employees to change who they are; it is usually much easier for them to change how they act.

Avoid making suggestions to employees about personal traits they should change; instead ③<u>to suggest</u> more acceptable ways of performing. For example, instead of ④<u>focusing</u> on a person's "unreliability," a manager might focus on the fact that the employee "has been late to work seven times this month." questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: to suggest → suggest: 명령문 구조에서는 동사원형 사용
det.analysis:
✅ ① Empathizing: 동명사 주어 — Empathizing with employees ... can be very helpful
✅ ② exhibited: 과거분사 후치수식 — the actions exhibited on the job
❌ ③ to suggest → suggest: 세미콜론 뒤 instead와 함께 명령문이므로 동사원형 suggest가 올바름
✅ ④ focusing: 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 — instead of focusing
det.tip: 세미콜론(;)은 두 독립절을 연결합니다. 'instead' 뒤에 명령문이 올 때 동사원형을 씁니다.

For example, instead of focusing on a person's "unreliability," a manager might focus on the fact that the employee "has been late to work seven times this month." It is difficult for employees to change who they are; it is usually much ④<u>easier</u> for them to change how they act.

✅ ④ easier: 비교급 — much easier for them
det.tip: 'figure out'은 이유를 밝히는 의미이므로 뒤에 'why'가 자연스럽습니다.

det.korean: dealt → dealing: when + 현재분사 분사구문에서는 -ing 형태 사용
det.analysis:
✅ ① acted: 현재완료의 과거분사 — has acted
❌ ② dealt → dealing: 'when dealing with'는 능동 분사구문. 'when dealt with'는 수동이라 문맥 부적절
✅ ③ performing: 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 — ways of performing
✅ ④ difficult: 가주어 It의 보어 형용사 — It is difficult
det.tip: 'when + -ing'는 능동 분사구문입니다. 주어가 능동적으로 행동할 때 현재분사를 씁니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 직원들의 관점을 이해하기 위해 공감하는 것은 매우 도움이 될 수 있다. 나쁜 것은 그 사람이 아니라 직장에서 보이는 행동이다. 직원들이 자신을 바꾸는 것은 어렵다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① understand: 직원들의 관점을 '이해하다'는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② good → bad: 'not the person who is bad'에서 문제가 되는 것을 말하는 문맥이므로 'bad'가 적절. 'good'은 반대 의미
✅ ③ change: 개인적 특성을 '바꿔야 한다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ difficult: 자신을 바꾸는 것이 '어렵다'는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: 'not A but B' 구문에서 부정적 의미의 형용사가 B(행동)에 연결됩니다.

det.korean: 공감은 도움이 될 수 있다. 개인적 특성에 대한 제안을 피하라. 더 바람직한 업무 수행 방식을 제안하라. 행동을 바꾸는 것은 훨씬 쉽다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ helpful: 공감이 '도움이 된다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② Avoid: 개인적 특성에 대한 제안을 '피하라'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ acceptable: '바람직한' 업무 수행 방식이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ① harder → easier: 행동 변화가 '쉽다(easier)'는 문맥이므로 'harder'는 반대 의미
det.tip: 글의 핵심 주장(행동 변화가 성격 변화보다 쉽다)을 파악하면 비교급의 적절성을 판단할 수 있습니다.

questions.passage: Managers frequently try to play psychologist, to "figure out" why an employee has acted in a certain way. Empathizing with employees in order to understand their point of view can be very helpful. However, when dealing with a problem area, in particular, remember that it is not the person who is bad, but the actions exhibited on the job. Avoid making suggestions to employees about personal traits they should change; instead suggest more acceptable ways of performing. For example, instead of focusing on a person's "unreliability," a manager might focus on the fact that the employee "has been late to work seven times this month." It is difficult for employees to change who they are; it is usually much easier for them to change how they act.
